hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the one-parameter diagonal restriction F(k) = M(k, k). The two terms are generated by specializing the parameter k to 1 and 2, respectively.
required_assumptions: M(k, k) is defined for k = 1 and k = 2.
hypotheses.rationale: Both non-identical terms share the same binary function M and lie on the diagonal where the first and second arguments are equal; they can be viewed as two samples of the diagonal one-parameter family F(k)=M(k,k).
